name: dsh-llm-quota-retry
description: Keep a DeepSeek Harness agent step alive through an exhausted account quota: after the base provider retry policy gives up on a QUOTA failure, retry the same request once per hour without an attempt limit, and publish the entering, leaving, and current state of that long-term retry to other plugins.
author: windwhiterain

meta.title: Quota Long-Term Retry
meta.description: Retries a model request once per hour, without an attempt limit, while the provider reports an exhausted quota or balance.
